S20.title: Final gate: accept ADR 0008 (Status line to Accepted, only after the owner's written acceptance of the plan is in the PR thread), set 008 status in docs/product/modules.md (owner decides the Depends-on cell, plan R-7), run the full suite with output pasted as evidence (GS-01..04, lint, sqlc, coverage >= 90 percent on internal/ipos, BR traceability).
S20.done_command: cd apps/api && go test -race ./... && cd ../.. && make lint-go && cd apps/api && sqlc generate && sqlc vet && git diff --exit-code internal/platform/db/dbgen && go test -race -coverprofile=$(mktemp) ./internal/ipos/... && cd ../.. && bash scripts/check-lint-boundaries.sh && bash scripts/check-br-traceability.sh && grep -q 'Status: Accepted' docs/adr/0008-in-transaction-module-signals.md && pnpm turbo run typecheck test build
